entries.introZh: 在二维场景中用武器、天气、液体和可生成的生物做物理实验，也可以治疗布娃娃或重置场地。
entries.descriptionSearch:
Your own 2D ragdoll sandbox. Shoot the dummy, blow him up, drop him in lava or let a dragon burn him.

Inspired by : Granule

CODE : "RELEASE" , "30KTHANKS!"

🔫 Guns, swords, chainsaws, bombs and nukes
⚡ Black holes, tornadoes, meteors and time stop
🧟‍♂️  Zombies, aliens, skeletons and creatures to spawn
🌊 Real sand, water, fire and lava
🩹 H heals everyone, R resets the room

Left click - grab and fling
Right click - use item
G - slow motion
Space - pause
F1 - all keys
